runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Kimchi Fried Rice, Confit Duck Legs with Puy Lentils, Slow-Roasted Tomatoes with Anchovy
runs.content:
1. Kimchi Fried Rice with Crispy Fried Egg — inspired by David Chang. A 20-minute fermented-pantry fix that turns leftover rice and a jar of turned kimchi into a craveable weeknight meal.
2. Confit Duck Legs with Puy Lentils — inspired by Anthony Bourdain. A weekend technique piece marking the turn toward autumn — classical French confit built on patience, fat and time.
3. Slow-Roasted Tomatoes with Anchovy, Garlic and Thyme — inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: the classic way to use up the last big tomato glut before the season turns.

runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Sheet-Pan Sausage & Sweetcorn Traybake, Dan Dan Noodles, Grilled Figs with Prosciutto & Blue Cheese
runs.content:
1. Sheet-Pan Sausage, Sweetcorn and Pepper Traybake — inspired by Lucinda Scala Quinn. A 40-minute, one-tray weeknight fix built on peak-season corn and peppers.
2. Dan Dan Noodles — inspired by Anthony Bourdain. A Sichuan technique piece: homemade chilli oil and numbing peppercorn balanced against salt, sour and heat.
3. Grilled Figs with Prosciutto, Blue Cheese and Honey — inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: an assembly built around figs just coming into season, barely cooked.
